documents.rightsNotes: The OSG e-Library record describes an English revised edition consolidating amendments only through the 14th Amendment of 2005. Do not treat that older copy as current without reconciling the Parliament 2025 document and subsequent amendments. Zanzibar's Constitution is a separate jurisdictional instrument and should be catalogued separately rather than merged into the Union Constitution.
